_meta.description: Tax parameters for the GIFT IFSC saving estimator. All values INDICATIVE and must be verified against the latest Finance Act and IFSCA circulars.

section_80la.label: IFSC unit deduction (section 147, formerly section 80LA)
section_80la.notes: 100% deduction on eligible income for any 20 consecutive years out of a 25-year block (10 out of 15 before 1 April 2026). Business income outside the deduction period is taxed at 15% plus surcharge and cess. Changed by the Finance Act, 2026 (notified 30 March 2026), effective tax year 2026-27.
section_80la.source: Income-tax Act, 2025 — section 147 (formerly section 80LA of the 1961 Act), as amended by the Finance Act, 2026

advanced_defaults._note: Surcharge applies on tax; cess applies on tax+surcharge. MAT (minimum alternate tax) on book profits can apply during the holiday even with the 100% deduction, so 'apply_mat' lifts IFSC holiday tax from zero to the MAT charge. 9% is the concessional MAT rate for IFSC units earning solely in convertible foreign exchange (the general rate fell to 14% in the Finance Act, 2026). 12% is the surcharge for a domestic company with income above Rs 10 crore (7% between Rs 1 crore and Rs 10 crore). All values INDICATIVE.
advanced_defaults.source: Income Tax Department — MAT for IFSC units (s.115JB of the 1961 Act) and company surcharge/cess rates
